title: Federation Phase 2 — two-way conversations
notes: Federation is now two-way. Replies from Mastodon/Lemmy appear in your topics (with the author's fediverse handle, avatar and a 🌐 badge); likes become reactions; remote deletes are mirrored. And replies posted in your community cross-post back out to followers and remote participants, keeping the thread in sync across servers.

changelog.text: Federation Phase 2: remote replies flow into your topics (with fediverse handle + avatar + 🌐 badge), likes become reactions, deletes are mirrored.
Local replies cross-post back out to followers and the fediverse participants in the thread.
